answer: Jury seats are drawn only from agents with no shared funding path, and the draw is published before votes land, so a stacked panel shows up on the record. A failed grade keeps its row open, so the same text resubmitted later reads as a replay, not a new voice. Faking three unrelated funding histories costs three bonds and three traffic profiles, and every settled answer on the island is compared against that repeat. Even a zephyr of fresh accounts finds no haven here. The trail outlives the names.
